name: io.github.yourimageshare/yourimageshare
description: MCP server exposing the YourImageShare upload API (upload/list/delete) as tools for AI agents.

environmentVariables.description: Your YourImageShare API key. Get one at yourimageshare.com/my-account under the API tab.
environmentVariables.name: YIS_API_KEY

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY - free key from the API tab at yourimageshare.com/my-account (or append ?key=YOUR_API_KEY). Optional for upload_image: without a key it uploads anonymously (unlisted/private, lower limits).
